entities.summary: Hiroyuki Sawano , stylized as Hiroyuki SAWANO, is a Japanese composer, arranger, lyricist, pianist, and music producer best known for his work on many anime series, video games, television dramas, and films. His works include the musical scores for Attack On Titan, Soul Link, Gigantic Formula, Zombie-Loan, Yoake Mae yori Ruriiro na, The Seven Deadly Sins, Sengoku Basara, Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn, Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative, Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway, Blue Exorcist, Aldnoah.Zero, Seraph of the End, Guilty Crown, Kill la Kill, Xenoblade Chronicles X, Re:Creators, Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress, Fanfare of Adolescence, 86 and Solo Leveling.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Hiroyuki Sawano's influential compositions have significantly impacted the anime and video game industries, contributing to the success of numerous critically acclaimed series such as Attack On Titan and The Seven Deadly Sins. His work has inspired a new generation of creators and fans alike.
